This is a self-declaration only. note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely claimed: dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and BOL number exist for Feb 2026 across Myanmar, Bolivia, Laos, Philippines and Honduras, all shipped from Ahmedabad ICD/air. Declared HS 300490 matches the observed records (30049099 / 30049069) - no HS correction needed. Domestic supply is only declared by the company's own website; no GST turnover band, tender or contract evidence was obtainable, so it is recorded as declared_only rather than confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures: null - ImportKey free view exposes shipment counts (456) but not value; no turnover data public in retrieved sources. Note the address discrepancy: ImportKey shows plant address 128/A, GIDC Phase I&II Naroda, while the website lists a corporate office at Anmol Business Centre, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad - consistent with a manufacturer with separate registered office. Role: manufacturer (WHO-GMP certified plant, commissioned 1993, Ahmedabad, Gujarat) - not a trader. No rejection grounds: entity is active and shipping.
